ava: Morning async check-in — quick pipeline / blockers / today
ava: What I did: demo with Acadia (POC agreed), sent SOW. Blockers: legal asked for EU dataflow diagram + KMS/HSM details.
ava: Today: follow up with Priya on KMS wording, ping security for a short blurb we can give the buyer.
ben: Nice. Can you drop the exact legal asks here? I'll prep a slide for tomorrow.
ava: Legal asks: 1) where keys are stored and CMAK options; 2) data residency for logs/metrics; 3) audit log retention and access controls. Also they want SOC2 evidence. See their note: <https://acadia.example/notes>.
priya: I can handle the KMS wording. @ej can you confirm: can Dedicated customers use customer-managed KMS in EU region? And what's the short blurb for on‑prem HSM support?
ej: Yes — Dedicated supports customer-managed KMS (Cloud KMS/Azure Key Vault) and Private can integrate with customer HSMs. On‑prem HSMs supported via PKCS#11 integration with our Private package; requires an architecture review and deployment checklist.
ej: Blurb to share with customer:
```
We support customer-managed keys (Cloud KMS, Azure Key Vault, GCP KMS) for Dedicated and Private deployments. On‑prem HSM integration is available for Private deployments using PKCS#11 with FIPS-validated modules; integration requires an architecture review and a short operations runbook. Audit logs for key access are available and can be retained according to your retention policy.
```
ben: That helps a lot — thanks. Customer timeline is ~6 weeks. Can we get an ETA for a formal architecture review?
ej: ETA: initial scoping and checklist in ~3 business days, full review 2–3 weeks depending on docs/availability. I'll start scoping today.
ava: Two quick follow-ups: 1) does enabling customer KMS change our latency SLA? 2) any ops/cost things we should call out?
ej: No measurable token latency change — envelope encryption + occasional key fetch/rotate on key rotation. Ops: need rotation cadence and key lifecycle docs. Cost: cloud KMS costs are separate (per-provider pricing) and typically small relative to per-token inference costs.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: note: Private-deploy-staging v2.4.1 maintenance scheduled 2026-03-19 02:00 UTC — test endpoints may be briefly unavailable.
priya: I pushed a one-pager with the KMS blurb and legal answers into the deal doc and flagged legal. @ava @ben link: <https://redwooddeals.example/acadia/onepager>
ben: Quick ops ask for eng: can someone sanity-check this logging/KMS config snippet before I send it to the customer? I'll flag @eng.
ben: snippet:
```
log_export: europe-logs
kms: cmk-eu-01
retention_days: 365
```
ava: Also small ask — can eng runtime review the integration sample for the customer PR? PR #4526 needs a quick review from @eng-runtime.
priya: I'll add the PR link and a short acceptance test to the deal doc.
ben: :thumbsup: I'll schedule the customer follow-up for tomorrow 10:00 CET. If security or eng needs anything before then, flag it here and I'll delay as needed.
ava: Thanks everyone — will post any legal replies here.
